steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow described by the case.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title so publishing can proceed.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add a usable line item matching the case’s product search as closely as the catalog allows.
Complete the pricing sheet fields required for publishing.
Invite one QA vendor so the event can be published.
Open the schedule drawer from the footer.
Confirm that the Schedule Event drawer opened.
Verify the schedule is using the immediate start mode.
Use duration-based ending rather than a fixed end time.
Verify that the configured 24-hour equivalent duration preset is offered.
Choose the 24-hour equivalent duration preset.
Capture the schedule drawer’s calculated end time for comparison after publishing.
Commit the schedule.
Verify the footer schedule chip reflects the selected duration.
Publish the configured RFQ and confirm the publish flow.
Confirm that publishing reached the real project page.
Verify that the published Project Details area exposes the bidding end time.
Compare the published bidding end time with the end time calculated in the schedule drawer.
